name: dep-up-surgeon
description: Production-oriented CLI that upgrades npm dependencies

paragraphs: A correctness and safety release from a full review of the tool. What you may notice:

--json consumers: project.isolatedLockfilesSource is now always "per-workspace-lockfiles", and project.yarnSupportsFocus is informational. New fields: transitiveAdvisories, upgraded[].section, overrides.attempts[].method.
features: Policy caps hold everywhere. maxVersion and allowMajorAfter now also bind linked-group members, coordinated fallbacks, the peer-range resolver and --dry-run plans — before, a group or a fallback could land a version the…
The branch matches the report. With --git-commit, override pins and the --fix-lockfile dedupe land in one extra commit. --open-pr refuses to push when --git-branch is the PR's base branch.

Safer file restore. Files the run rewrote are only restored inside the project directory, and the changed version is first copied to nodemodules/.cache/dep-up-surgeon/side-effects/, so an edit you saved mid-run is never…

Peer conflicts. Dependents npm lists under Found: whose range is already satisfied are no longer treated as blockers; blockers are never moved below their installed version; a resolver answer that changes nothing is…

undo and --retry-failed. Override pins are reverted newest first, and a pin changed since the run is skipped as drifted. A report replayed with --file edits this checkout, not the path recorded on the CI machine.…
